channels.title: Channels
channels.description: Public channel usernames or t.me links, e.g. durov or https://t.me/telegram. Channels must be public with web preview enabled.

maxMessagesPerChannel.title: Max messages per channel
maxMessagesPerChannel.description: How deep to paginate each channel (newest first, about 20 messages per page).

maxMessages.title: Max messages total
maxMessages.description: Maximum message rows across all channels. First 10 message rows per run are free.

includeChannelInfo.title: Include channel info rows
includeChannelInfo.description: Add one free channel_info row per channel with title, description, subscriber count and photo.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. The t.me preview pages are a tolerant public source, so proxy is off by default. Supply one only if you run very large pulls and hit rate limits.
